notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Warden of the Eye and Palinchron, targeting Warden of the Eye
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Warden of the Eye and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.
